headline: Oregon Couple Gets $16K HVAC System Through 'Feel the Love' Program
meta_description: Diane and Brian Johnsen of Beaverton received a free heating and cooling system worth $16,000 through Lennox's Feel the Love program, which has aided over 3,10…
summary_short: An Oregon couple facing financial hardship received a complete HVAC system valued at $16,000 at no cost through a community assistance initiative.
body:
Diane and Brian Johnsen of Beaverton, Oregon, can now face the winter months with comfort and peace of mind after receiving a complete heating and cooling system installed in their home at no cost. The new HVAC equipment, valued at approximately $16,000, was installed by local contractor Aviator Heating & Cooling as part of the Lennox Feel the Love program—a community initiative designed to help qualifying homeowners receive essential home improvements for free. The gift arrives at a time when the couple has been navigating significant financial pressures, including circumstances that required Diane to work three jobs to help maintain their mortgage payments.

When the Johnsens' existing HVAC system could no longer be repaired, they turned to the Feel the Love program for assistance. The donation included not only the new energy-efficient heating and cooling system but also a modern thermostat, with Aviator handling the complete on-site installation. Before-and-after photos reveal the transformation from their home's aging furnace to the reliable equipment that will serve them throughout their retirement years. "Are you kidding? We were ecstatic," Brian told KOIN-TV news, while Diane reflected on what the gift means: "Especially in our retirement years, it means the world to us."

The Lennox Feel the Love program has been quietly transforming households since 2009, providing HVAC system donations to more than 3,100 families in need. Aviator Heating & Cooling remains committed to helping families throughout Beaverton, Portland, and surrounding Oregon and southeastern Washington communities. Those facing similar circumstances can submit a nomination through the program's webpage to explore whether they qualify for assistance.
quick_facts: Retired couple in Beaverton, Oregon received $16,000 HVAC system free
Lennox Feel the Love program has aided over 3,100 families since 2009
Local contractor Aviator Heating & Cooling performed installation at no cost
Wife worked three jobs to maintain mortgage before assistance received
